pages.text: $(bold)Pet Nest$()$(br)Tamed cats and dogs nearby come to settle in; one nest houses one pet. Should they pass away, they reappear here the next day.
$(bold)Wander Mode$()$(br)Lets a pet roam freely around its nest; blow the $(bold)Whistle$() and a wandering pet switches to following.
$(bold)Pet Revival$()$(br)A pet that has settled into a nest and later dies will revive in the nest the following day.
